item.title: Ramu Grid hit by total system outage; restoration underway
item.description: PNG Power Management has notified the general public and valued customers that the Ramu Grid is currently experiencing a sudden total system outage. The collapse has disconnected power across the Highlands, Madang, and Lae regions. Restoration efforts are now in progress, with technical teams focused on recovering supply from the Ramu Hydropower Station. item.title: Divine Word University prepares for 2026 student registration and celebrates 30 years of service
item.description: Staff of Divine Word University (DWU) have completed two weeks of resumption activities in preparation for student registration for the 2026 academic year. Registration will commence on 2 February and conclude on 13 February 2026 across all DWU campuses. The University Registrar has indicated that enrolment numbers are expected to reach 2,030 students at the Madang campus, 625 in Wewak, 573 in Rabaul, and 133 in Port Moresby. item.title: Cooper Bai cleared of serious injury after road accident
item.description: Papua New Guinean international rugby League prospect and Gold Coast Titans rookie Cooper Bai has avoided serious injury following a car accident earlier this week.
